notes: Counts describe the frozen adaptive sample, not population risk.
Capacity scatter omits all-unsafe configurations; full tables retain them.
Decision quality uses the largest observed safe load even for nonmonotone sequences; see flags in tables.
Nominal relaxed-TPOT: four strict best-set mismatches (S), two tie-break mismatches (T).
Mitigation shows 12 main five-candidate trials only; line is mean over defined qualities, dots are individual trials.
Conditional replay uses a preconstructed reference-informed grid; at most five replay queries do not include grid construction or solve planning from scratch.
Derating is a 20% target with grid snapping, not a fixed realized 20% reduction.
